generatedCommentsNodes.comment: Since the test class is named `LogsIndexModeFullClusterRestartIT` and the test method is `testLogsIndexing`, removing the `cluster.logsdb.enabled` setting means the test now relies on logs index mode being enabled by default (or via the `data-streams` module) in the version under test. If that assumption is not guaranteed across all supported old-cluster versions, the test could silently pass without actually exercising the logs-index-mode code path. If the intent is that logs index mode is always on in the target version, this is fine; otherwise, a brief comment or assertion in the test verifying the mode is active would make the intent explicit and guard against future regressions.
